hypotheses.C0_different_codebooks_break_unseen_rela: No layer has minimum leave-one-relation-out write R2 >=0.30 across every ordered different-codebook pair/relation.
hypotheses.C1_late_invariance_is_codebook_relative: At Layer 3, same-codebook mean write R2 exceeds different-codebook R2 by >=0.30 and same-rule mapped fidelity exceeds it by >=0.30.
hypotheses.C2_target_internal_answer_interface_surv: At Layer 3, the target model's own generic answer edit retains fidelity >=0.70 to its semantic edit despite cross-codebook alignment failure.
hypotheses.C3_wrong_rule_control_remains_noncausal: At Layer 3, mapped same-rule accuracy does not exceed norm-matched wrong-rule accuracy by >=0.15 when different-codebook alignment is invalid.
